description.en:
Sets the name shown for a match team. The name is a text key (hashed with CRC32 and stored in the team's match setup), so the displayed name is localised.
The second argument is also stored in the team's setup, in a 16-bit field; what reads it was not identified. Nothing is changed if the name argument is not a string.
Team: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Stored in a 16-bit field of the team setup; meaning not identified. The shipped scripts always pass 1.
Text key of the team name, e.g. "name_te0997".

true once the call has run.
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments were given.

examples.case: Renaming the player's team for a special match (real usage)
examples.code:
// Show a special team name on the player's side
CMND_BTL_SET_TEAM_NAME(0, 1, "name_te0997");
